title: EDG Community Update: Week of August 22nd, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- [Kucoin Trading Competition](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1563866511428796418), a series of 3 campaigns got approved by the community.
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects can upgrade their nodes to the [pre-release v3.5.1](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.5.1) to be prepared in advance for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade's on-chain democracy proposal.
- Upcoming Activities/Events: The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns(ongoing), Kabocha's Community Mods Onboarding Quiz

<iframe width="720" height="407" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/CxkPLZh7zc8" title="Kabocha Technical AMA" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- [The Cutting Edge Conquest round 4 aka the 'Sticker Competition'](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1564331679162023937) has been concluded and the winners have been announced.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-aug-21/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink's oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)'s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.

## **Governance**

- Referendum #103
